```sql
WITH p AS (
    SELECT %(limit)s::bigint + COALESCE(%(offset)s::bigint, 0) AS n
)
SELECT u.id, u.tenant_id, u.table_name, u.row_id, u.action,
       u.old_data, u.new_data, u.actor_id, u.is_system, u.created_at
  FROM (
        (SELECT a.*
           FROM audit_log a
          WHERE %(row_id)s::uuid IS NOT NULL
            AND a.row_id = %(row_id)s::uuid
            AND a.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
            AND (%(table_name)s::text IS NULL OR a.table_name = %(table_name)s::text)
            AND a.created_at >= %(from)s
            AND a.created_at <  %(to)s
          ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC
          LIMIT (SELECT n FROM p))
        UNION ALL
        (SELECT a.*
           FROM audit_log a
          WHERE %(row_id)s::uuid IS NULL
            AND %(table_name)s::text IS NOT NULL
            AND a.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
            AND a.table_name = %(table_name)s::text
            AND a.created_at >= %(from)s
            AND a.created_at <  %(to)s
          ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC
          LIMIT (SELECT n FROM p))
        UNION ALL
        (SELECT a.*
           FROM audit_log a
          WHERE %(row_id)s::uuid IS NULL
            AND %(table_name)s::text IS NULL
            AND a.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
            AND a.created_at >= %(from)s
            AND a.created_at <  %(to)s
          ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC
          LIMIT (SELECT n FROM p))
       ) u
 ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.id DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s OFFSET %(offset)s
```

De `OR ... IS NULL`-filters verhinderen dat de planner (zeker bij generieke plans) de selectieve indexen op `row_id` of `(tenant_id, table_name)` gebruikt. Daarom is de query opgesplitst in drie elkaar uitsluitende takken, elk met een eigen gerichte indexstrategie. Niet-toepasselijke takken worden via een one-time filter direct overgeslagen, en elke tak stopt na `limit + offset` rijen, waarna de buitenste ORDER BY/LIMIT/OFFSET exact dezelfde pagina oplevert.
